source_snapshot.procedure: Set NTP synchronization, change the NTP server date/time, and check UBB IP availability after BMC firmware flash.
source_snapshot.criteria: System time matches and follows the NTP server; BMC network settings do not change and the Virtual NIC remains pingable.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL but only attempts a malformed insecure NTP PATCH/readback and omits synchronization, flash, UBB and Virtual-NIC coverage.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION; adds trusted state-change controls but does not explicitly govern the firmware-flash lifecycle.

old_problem: The historical review correctly identified materially different NTP and firmware/network state machines and refused to omit either, but concluded an engineer must choose or split them. The source itself supplies three ordered requirements, so all can instead be retained as separately accepted checkpoints with independent gates and evidence; UBB IP and Virtual NIC are both preserved without assuming equivalence.
disposition_reason: Checkpoint A configures the BMC's discovered NTP resource and proves convergence; Checkpoint B changes only an isolated NTP source within an approved bounded offset and proves tracking; Checkpoint C consumes a real, separately authorized signed BMC firmware-flash package and proves BMC LAN configuration plus both UBB-IP and Virtual-NIC reachability persist. DMTF defines ManagerNetworkProtocol NTP and UpdateService boundaries, and RFC 5905 defines NTP behavior, but none supplies target-specific paths, clock tolerances, UBB identity or a safe OEM flash command. Those remain Project Configuration and an independent flash safety package. Splitting verdicts resolves the source conflict without deleting, conflating or fabricating coverage.
decision_basis: XLSX row 838, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2 and historical record were directly reviewed.

DMTF ManagerNetworkProtocol defines user-supplied `NTPServers` and `ProtocolEnabled` as manager NTP settings, while actual resource discovery, writable schema and synchronization status remain implementation-specific.
RFC 5905 defines NTP synchronization behavior; one HTTP success or immediate clock readback is not evidence of convergence or following a changed source.
DMTF UpdateService defines standard update resources/actions but permits vendor-defined image behavior; a compatible signed image, target, activation and recovery cannot be guessed.

ED-07 requires any approved flash coverage and pre/post versions to remain behind separate authorization; ED-15 requires project-approved time/reachability thresholds; ED-20 preserves all named targets; ED-38 forbids automatic retry and unapproved state changes.

test_case.test_name: Verify BMC NTP tracking and preserve BMC/UBB/Virtual-NIC networking across an authorized firmware flash
test_case.purpose: A: configure the exact BMC manager to an approved isolated NTP source and prove authoritative convergence. B: prove the BMC clock follows one approved bounded source-time change and returns to baseline. C: after a real separately authorized BMC firmware flash, prove source/target firmware versions, unchanged BMC LAN settings, UBB-IP availability and Virtual-NIC reachability from their approved observers.
required_package: BMC identity/firmware, trusted Redfish service discovery, actual Manager/NetworkProtocol/time/status resources, schema/writability/ETag rules and protected credentials

Approved isolated NTP server with all affected clients inventoried, baseline time, bounded change, timezone/UTC/leap policy, synchronization-status oracle, offset tolerance and convergence/follow/restore windows
Exact BMC LAN baseline fields and allowed intended differences, plus independently defined UBB component/IP/interface and Virtual-NIC name/MAC/IP/route/observer/reachability criteria

Separate approved BMC flash package: compatible signed image hash, source/target versions, vendor/project tool or discovered UpdateService action, exact target, host/power state, activation/reset behavior, timeout and success evidence
Independent OOB/recovery image or rollback method, configuration backups, maintenance authorization and stop conditions for both clock and flash transitions
Pinned reviewed internal Script revision/hash; its NTP and firmware/network steps, payload construction, secret handling and recovery must be approved before use
test_case.test_command: Preserve BMC identity/version, complete NTP/time/timezone/sync status, BMC LAN settings, UBB-IP and Virtual-NIC identity/routes/reachability, logs and rollback values. Discover the actual Manager.NetworkProtocol and time/status resources through Redfish; construct the NTP JSON structurally, use trusted TLS/protected authentication and present the exact ETag-aware write for approval. Checkpoint A: perform one approved NTP update, re-read persistence and sample authoritative sync/offset until the approved convergence window ends. Checkpoint B: through the isolated server's approved control, apply one bounded time change, record server/BMC samples through the follow window, restore the source and prove reconvergence; never alter a shared production NTP server. Checkpoint C: only under a separately approved firmware-update record, execute its exact signed image/tool/target/activation/recovery procedure, capture pre/post firmware versions, then compare all protected BMC LAN fields and independently verify the named UBB IP and Virtual NIC from their approved observers. Restore NTP/configuration per plan. No flash command or OEM payload is inferred by this review, and no write, time change, flash, reset or ping was executed here.
test_case.expected_result: A: the intended manager persists the approved NTP configuration and reaches the approved synchronized state/offset within the convergence window. B: after the single bounded source change, BMC time follows within the approved offset/window and reconverges after server restoration with audit continuity accounted for. C: the signed authorized image updates the intended BMC from the approved source to target version and completes required activation/recovery; all protected BMC LAN settings equal baseline, the exact UBB IP is available, and the exact Virtual NIC remains link/address/route-correct and pingable within its approved loss/latency window. Final NTP, network, firmware and management health match the approved retained state.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: Record A, B and C separately; overall PASS requires all three. A needs persisted configuration plus authoritative sync/offset samples, not HTTP success. B needs timestamped server and BMC samples before/during/after the approved stimulus, not a single DateTime. C needs actual flash authorization/execution, signed image and pre/post version proof plus field-level BMC LAN equality and separate UBB-IP and Virtual-NIC results; NTP evidence cannot substitute. Out-of-tolerance time, failure to reconverge, wrong manager/server/image/target, unapproved network drift, unavailable UBB IP, failed Virtual-NIC reachability, flash/activation/recovery failure or lost management is FAIL. Missing any project binding or independent flash package is NOT READY, not renewed Pending or PASS.
safety_gate: Never change a shared production NTP server. Use an isolated source, inventory its clients and approve a bounded offset/window that will not invalidate TLS, credentials, audit or scheduled tasks.
Discover and validate the actual Redfish resource/schema/ETag; never use `curl -k`, visible Basic credentials, assumed `/Managers/bmc` paths or the DeepSeek single-quoted literal payload.
Preserve logs and annotate clock discontinuity; do not clear SEL, dmesg or syslog or accept timestamp disorder without normalization evidence.
Do not flash, stage, activate, reset or power-cycle until the separate signed vendor/project package, exact image/target, current power state, backup and recovery are explicitly approved.
A standard UpdateService presence does not authorize an OEM image or command; stop on unsupported target, signature/version mismatch, task error or recovery uncertainty.
Do not automatically retry any NTP write, time stimulus, firmware transfer/activation or network check. Preserve first-failure state and use independent OOB recovery.
expected_evidence: BMC/firmware identity, Redfish discovery/schema/ETag, protected request audit and complete before/after NTP/time/timezone/network state
Isolated NTP identity/configuration and authoritative sync/offset samples across baseline, convergence, bounded source change, follow and restored reconvergence windows
Exact structured NTP payload/readback, intended-only diff, rollback/final state and timestamp-discontinuity annotation with preserved logs
BMC LAN protected-field baseline and post-flash comparison plus separate UBB IP and Virtual-NIC identity/MAC/IP/link/route/ping evidence from approved observers
Independent flash approval; signed image hash; source/target version; exact reviewed tool/action/target; task/progress/activation/reset and recovery evidence
Final BMC/NTP/network/UBB/Virtual-NIC/OOB health, Script hash/review if used and three separate engineer-owned verdicts
test_case.recovery: For NTP failure or dangerous clock step, stop further writes, retain clock-discontinuity evidence, use independent OOB access, restore the saved NTP/time configuration and isolated server baseline, and verify sync, certificates, sessions and logs. For flash/task/activation failure, do not retry or power-cycle ad hoc; invoke only the separately approved vendor recovery/rollback image and power-state procedure, preserve task and pre/post evidence, restore saved BMC network settings if supported, then verify BMC, UBB and Virtual-NIC paths. Escalate when the approved recovery cannot restore management.

source_conflict.reason: NTP configuration, source tracking and post-flash network persistence are retained as three independent checkpoints; UBB IP and Virtual NIC are both tested without asserting they are the same target.

blocked.reason: The source's ordered coverage can be executed safely through independent gates; OEM flash specifics and platform identities are mandatory readiness packages rather than guessed semantics.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Redfish bindings, NTP oracle/tolerances/stimulus, BMC/UBB/Virtual-NIC maps, and an independently approved signed BMC flash/image/tool/activation/recovery package.
